verses.1: A man may plan his heart, but the answer of his tongue is from the LORD.
verses.2: Every way of a man is right in his eyes, but the LORD weighs the spirits.
verses.3: Commit your works to the LORD, and your plans will be established.
verses.4: The LORD has made all things for His purpose, even the wicked for a day of evil.
verses.5: The arrogance of the proud is an abomination to the LORD; no hand that acts unjustly will go unpunished.
verses.6: In steadfast love and truth, iniquity is atoned for; and in the fear of the LORD, one turns from evil.
verses.7: In the favor of the LORD a man’s ways are pleasing; even his enemies will make peace with him.
verses.8: Better a little with righteousness than much wealth with injustice.
verses.9: The heart of a man may plan his way, but the LORD establishes his steps.
verses.10: A command is on the lips of the king; in judgment, he does not alter his mouth.
verses.11: A balance and weights of justice belong to the LORD; all the works of His hands are measured.
verses.12: The doing of evil is an abomination to kings, for on righteousness a throne is established.
verses.13: The desire of kings is the lips of justice; and one who speaks uprightly is loved.
verses.14: The anger of a king is like the messenger of death, but a wise man will atone for it.
verses.15: The light of a king’s face gives life, and his favor is like a cloud bringing rain.
verses.16: Acquire wisdom—how much better it is than silver! Acquire understanding—how much better it is than gold!
verses.17: The path of the upright turns away from evil; the one who guards his soul keeps his way.
verses.18: Before a fall is pride, and before a stumble is a proud heart.
verses.19: Better is a humble spirit among the lowly than the dividing of spoils among the proud.
verses.20: A discerning man will find good, and one who puts trust in the LORD will be blessed.
verses.21: One who is wise of heart is called understanding; and the sweetness of his lips increases learning.
verses.22: A source of life is wisdom to the one who possesses it; but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.23: A wise heart will guide its mouth, and on its lips it will add learning.
verses.24: Words of the wise are honeyed; how sweet they are to the soul, and how healing to the bones!
verses.25: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the ways of death.
verses.26: The soul of the worker labors for himself, for his mouth is driven by his hunger.
verses.27: A man of mischief plots evil, and on his tongue a burning flame lies ready.
verses.28: A man of deceit sends a messenger, and a divisive tongue kindles a flame.
verses.29: A violent man entices his friend and leads him down a path that is not good.
verses.30: One whose eyes are fixed to plot deception, whose lips mark out evil, he is a furnace of wickedness.
verses.31: The crown of old age is a life lived in righteousness.
verses.32: Better is a patient man than a warrior, and one who rules his spirit than one who captures a city.
verses.33: The casting of the lot is in the lap, but the whole judgment is from the LORD.

notes:
Notes
- v. 33: "The casting of the lot is in the lap" — the image of the lot (goral) being cast into the lap (kopher) is a metaphor for human decision-making, while the final outcome ("the whole judgment") is reserved to the LORD.
